facts.fact: 生日无记录、日期随母亲 whims 变、总在秋天——「Until today.」今天不是秋天她也送礼物
facts.anchor: It is then, and only then, that she bestows a gift upon me.

facts.fact: 腐果臭盖血味；Ladies 尸体被母亲摆上桌（Bellamy 无头）——「a crude display, a game of waiting. I will not remove them, and nor will she.」
facts.anchor: I will not remove them, and nor will she.

facts.fact: 母亲吟「bottle the hours up...grind into sand and keep it always」——Rue 觉得陌生：「I feel as though I do not know her. Not like this.」

生日礼物：白毛手套——Veronica 时代结束「they are hers and hers alone」；「There was enough for just one pair...There was so very little to work with, but there will be more rats again soon enough...They will come back now that it is safe for them.」——毛=白猫皮！白猫死了
facts.anchor: they are hers and hers alone

facts.fact: 「with a sudden sick hollowness, I know」；戴上手套「For a moment it feels like blood. I do not dare take them off.」——「I do not think I can let you go, Rue. I do not wish to be alone.」
facts.anchor: It takes everything I have in me not to scream.

facts.fact: 手套曾带来安慰（Hope 双关）——「There is barely anything left inside me now but emptiness. I am a well, bottomless and dark. The flicker of happiness I left before is a fleeting beat, gone in a blink」
facts.anchor: I am a well, bottomless and dark.

facts.fact: 埋白猫时不许脱手套——「I hold them to my chest, needing their warmth despite the sunlight streaming down」；随后投奔 Anne（「in her arms before the sound echoes」）
facts.anchor: She would not let me take them off to bury her.

facts.fact: Anne 家崩溃：「My knees give, the gloves fall to the floor」；Oren 赶到「There has been illness in town…are you well?」（鼠疫！）——「Please help me」——第一次直接求救；「He does not ask me to stay...Though a part of me wishes he had asked.」

「Will you love me like this? In snatched moments of time, painted with horrors I will not walk away from?」——「With all the love I have, my darling.」； wine「It fits there, that little piece of me, like it belongs」
facts.anchor: With all the love I have, my darling.

facts.fact: Anne 宣布怀孕（spring baby）——「our children will play together, Rue, imagine that and—」被 Oren 摇头打断；Anne 收回「If you ever… In time, perhaps.」
facts.anchor: Oren gives a slight shake of his head
